implementation.note: The four PR #203 compiler repairs are present on this integration tree; the original Windows MSVC target builds are documented by the source branch.

architecture.note: The patch changes compiler spelling and raw literal boundaries in existing owners; no ownership, ECS or runtime dependency changes.

native_api.note: MapGrid and MobBehaviour retain their signatures and semantics; only local identifiers change.

skill.note: Compiler portability repair adds no authoring operation or skill surface.

mcp.note: No MCP method or schema changes; the existing MCP target was built on the source Windows branch.

studio.note: No Studio feature or control changes; the existing Studio target was built on the source Windows branch.

inspector.note: No inspected data or UI behavior changes.

persistence.note: No persistence format or journal behavior changes; the MoveFile macro is undefined only after windows.h.

graphs.note: No graph asset or execution changes.

performance.note: The embedded shader source is byte-identical after concatenation, and the remaining edits only rename local identifiers or undefine a macro; no runtime algorithm changes.

platforms.note: The source branch reports successful Windows 11 MSVC 19.44 Release builds of aiversemcp, aiversebuild and aiverse_studio; this integrator built aiversemcp and aiversebuild on Mac.

dependencies.note: No package, dependency or build setting is added.

examples.note: No new API or data format needs an example.

tests.note: Merged-tree Mac quick gate built and passed 551/551 CTest tests (five GPU frame tests were CTest Skipped); focused SpectraFX contract and Metal GPU tests were rerun with recorded SHA provenance.

handoff.note: Preparation, source code stage and their exact commit SHAs are documented.

documentation.note: The source handoff explains the compiler failures and limits; the Builds and platforms roadmap records the integration.

publishing.note: This compiler repair produces no new visible output or web demo.
